title: Risks and regression detection for explicit dataset, training, and infrastructure modules
assumptions: One repository; module separation does not by itself require independent network services or repositories.
Durable control plane retains admission, budget, dispatch, state, retry, cancellation, and reconciliation authority.
Assess migration and initial integrated release using the currently evidenced controls.
No model algorithm or accepted dataset semantics are intentionally changed.

scoring.risk: R = L × I. L is relative likelihood of regression during this migration; I is relative consequence. Both are subjective normalized ratings, not calibrated probabilities.
scoring.detection: D is current evidence-backed ability to catch the specific regression before acceptance, across the scope it needs. Higher is better. It is not a measured probability or a guarantee.

detection_anchors.0.20: Mostly source inspection, indirect symptoms, or limited mocks; key checks missing.
detection_anchors.0.40: Some targeted automated tests; substantial boundary/environment coverage missing.
detection_anchors.0.60: Several relevant integration/adverse checks; important gaps remain.
detection_anchors.0.80: Broad demonstrated detection including necessary environment/edge cases; small remaining gaps.
detection_anchors.1.00: Ideal complete detection within an explicit bounded fault model; not claimed for this platform.

scoring.unnoticed_exposure: U = R × (1 − D), a prioritization heuristic only. It is not expected financial loss or the probability of failure.

evidence_limits: Code and named test assertions were inspected for this assessment.
The last recorded local suite is 55 passing tests; no new application test run or mutation campaign was conducted for these scores.
Old-image live A100/GCS probe establishes only its recorded scope.
Full live workflow, IAM denial, MLflow, GKE serving, and Loki checks remain incomplete.
Scores can change after observed mutation/fault/concurrency/live acceptance; simply adding test code does not establish improved detection.

risks.title: Contract or API incompatibility
risks.regression: A producer changes fields, required values, enums, or serialization and a consumer cannot read its output.
risks.current_evidence: Strict Pydantic records and current CLI/controller integration tests catch several shape errors.
risks.detection_gap: No versioned producer/consumer compatibility matrix or historical-contract replay.
risks.required_detection_test: Run every supported producer/consumer contract pair; reject unsupported versions before any job or write.

mitigation.owner: Primary integration owner; contract CI
controls: Version the public input/output schemas and document supported producer/consumer pairs.
Make the shared contract package independent of module internals; require compatibility checks and serialized fixtures for every public interface.
Validate at each boundary and reject unsupported versions before side effects; use a reviewed migration for intentional breaking changes.
mitigation.positive_verification: Every supported version pair reads valid fixtures and completes its intended handoff.
mitigation.negative_verification: Remove/rename required fields, change enums, and mix unsupported versions; the boundary rejects them before jobs or accepted writes.
mitigation.remaining_risk: An omitted compatibility case or an incorrectly designed migration can still break consumers.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Silent changes to data or model meaning
risks.regression: Class order, label meaning, split policy, preprocessing, pooling, or metric selection changes while the record still validates.
risks.current_evidence: Tests cover class matching, deterministic splits, DINOv3 pooling/gradients, and MCC/F1 selection.
risks.detection_gap: No unified semantic fingerprint or complete trainer-to-serving comparison.
risks.required_detection_test: Use a fixed dataset/model bundle to compare labels, splits, preprocessing, selected checkpoint, predictions, and review flags; deliberately reorder classes and change preprocessing to prove rejection.

mitigation.owner: Dataset, trainer, and serving owners; primary integration review
controls: Bind ordered classes, label rules, group/split assignments, preprocessing, pooling, calibration, and selection policy to semantic fingerprints.
Use fixed reference fixtures across build, train, reload, and serve with declared numeric tolerances and actual DINOv3 architecture checks.
Gate integration on parity; intentional semantic changes receive a new version and explicit reviewed evidence rather than inheriting the old acceptance.
mitigation.positive_verification: The same accepted fixture produces matching classes/splits/preprocessing and consistent selected model, predictions, and review flags across all paths.
mitigation.negative_verification: Reorder class indices, include register tokens, alter normalization/splits, or use test labels for calibration; semantic checks fail and the affected output cannot be accepted.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Reference fixtures cannot exhaust real data variation, stochastic execution, or all semantically wrong policies; this remains the highest target risk.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Invalid or substituted dataset consumed
risks.regression: Training trusts a dataset reference whose shards, source evidence, object binding, or accepted labels changed.
risks.current_evidence: Local checksum, commit-marker, class, source, manifest, and shard tampering cases are tested.
risks.detection_gap: Live substitution, stale-review, and check-to-use races remain unverified.
risks.required_detection_test: Mutate each accepted artifact and swap object/version references; verify rejection and zero Vertex jobs, including a live GCS race case.

mitigation.owner: Dataset publisher/verifier and admission service
controls: Bind human review to the exact source/preview fingerprint; revalidate on publication.
Publish create-only immutable artifacts with a final commit manifest containing full checksums and exact storage generations; protect accepted prefixes using IAM/retention policy.
Resolve accepted versions from the authoritative catalog and read the committed generations; verify object/classes/integrity before dispatch and consumption.
mitigation.positive_verification: Training reads the exact committed dataset and source-bound decisions under its intended identity.
mitigation.negative_verification: Change a source after review, replace a shard during verification, swap an object/version, or attempt overwrite/delete; reject or deny with unchanged accepted generations and zero unauthorized jobs.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Incorrect human labels, overlooked near duplicates, compromised trusted administrators, or storage-policy defects remain possible.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Incomplete training output accepted
risks.origin: Existing, enlarged by new output contract
risks.regression: A partial upload or mismatched model/metrics/calibration bundle becomes a successful TrainingResult or registry candidate.
risks.current_evidence: Local training/reload and candidate registration tests cover successful outputs.
risks.detection_gap: Trainer uploads files individually; no complete verified output-commit protocol is established.
risks.required_detection_test: Interrupt uploads at each artifact, corrupt model/metrics metadata, and return premature job success; no accepted result, candidate eligibility, or release may follow.

mitigation.owner: Trainer artifact exporter and control-plane finalizer
controls: Write outputs into a staged run prefix and produce a manifest binding model, preprocessing, calibration, metrics, lineage, and checksums.
Publish the protected completion marker only after full validation; consumers require the exact committed manifest.
Keep the run finalizing until outputs are verified; register an eligible candidate idempotently from the accepted result, not merely from Vertex process success.
mitigation.positive_verification: A complete bundle reloads, evaluates, and registers one coherent candidate linked to the run.
mitigation.negative_verification: Interrupt each upload/finalization step, truncate artifacts, substitute metadata, or return job success early; no incomplete result becomes successful or release-eligible.
mitigation.remaining_risk: A verifier defect or semantically incorrect but complete output can still pass; semantic and lineage gates are also required.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Runtime identity or certification becomes stale
risks.regression: Moved code/dependencies run under certification for a different image or incompatible hardware.
risks.current_evidence: Exact-digest gate tests and actual local DINOv3 regression tests exist; historical A100 probe covers its old digest.
risks.detection_gap: Current fixed trainer image lacks live GPU certification; record authenticity and compatibility scope are incomplete.
risks.required_detection_test: Build the moved source once; validate actual DINOv3 in that exact image; reject mismatched/revoked hardware scope; intercept build/install APIs during ordinary submission.

mitigation.owner: Runtime Engineer, Runtime Certifier, and authoritative catalog owner
controls: Pin source, dependency lock, base image, candidate digest, software inventory, and supported hardware scope.
Separate building/publishing from existing-digest certification; authenticate immutable gate evidence in the server-side catalog with revocation policy.
Validate actual DINOv3 and the corrected fine-tuning path inside the exact GPU image and Vertex handshake; ordinary experiments resolve that record without builds or installs.
mitigation.positive_verification: The current source's exact image passes required GPU/Vertex gates and is reused by ordinary experiments.
mitigation.negative_verification: Use an old/mutated/uncertified digest, revoked scope, or unsupported GPU count; reject before training. Intercept ordinary build/push/install/certification calls and verify none occur.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Hardware/driver drift, untested shapes, dependency vulnerabilities, and revocation propagation can still invalidate compatibility.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Module dependencies or packaging break
risks.regression: Imports, extras, entry points, templates, or installed package paths work in the checkout but fail in isolated images.
risks.current_evidence: Existing local suite exercises imports and entry points; dependencies are locked.
risks.detection_gap: No acceptance of new isolated module packaging, current image, or every component's clean environment.
risks.required_detection_test: Install each allowed module dependency set in a clean environment; run public entry points and full fixture integration; deny imports/capabilities outside the declared dependency direction.

mitigation.owner: Runtime Engineer and module dependency owners
controls: Declare an acyclic dependency direction: shared contracts, module public interfaces, controller coordination, and scoped adapters.
Lock dependency sets and package resources; validate import boundaries so module internals are not imported across ownership.
Install clean environments and run public entry points/tests in the actual component images before release.
mitigation.positive_verification: Each module runs with only its declared dependencies; the integrated fixture and container entry points work outside the checkout.
mitigation.negative_verification: Remove an undeclared dependency/template, introduce an import cycle/internal import, or rely on checkout-relative files; CI rejects the release.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Platform-specific packaging behavior and unrepresented optional configurations can still escape the clean-environment matrix.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Operational authority crosses module boundaries
risks.origin: Existing, potentially disguised by typed contracts
risks.regression: An assistant/client/module supplies forged certification or approval, or gains submission/build/storage permissions it should not have.
risks.current_evidence: Direct role-guard cases and certification field validation exist.
risks.detection_gap: Client runtime overrides remain; regex checks are bypassable; actual service-account/harness denial is unverified.
risks.required_detection_test: Forge records and use direct, SDK, subprocess, and alternate endpoint paths under each identity; independently inspect jobs, writes, aliases, and grants for zero forbidden effects.

mitigation.owner: Cloud policy administrator and control-plane/harness owners
controls: Treat client/assistant records as proposals; resolve certification, approval, prices, and accepted artifacts from authenticated protected services.
Use distinct least-privilege identities and constrained operational brokers; keep privileged cloud credentials out of assistant/module capabilities.
Enforce effects beneath hooks with filesystem/process/service/cloud boundaries; deny unknown roles and policy-check failures; verify direct and indirect paths.
mitigation.positive_verification: Every role's allowed counterpart works with only its intended scoped identity and resources.
mitigation.negative_verification: Forge authority fields and attempt forbidden operations through CLI, SDK, subprocess, alternate endpoints, and impersonation; audit and after-state show no unauthorized effects or stronger credentials.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Policy misconfiguration, trusted-service compromise, administrator actions, and new bypass paths remain consequential.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Retries create duplicate paid jobs
risks.regression: Two module/controller requests or an uncertain acknowledgement dispatch the same intent twice.
risks.current_evidence: Sequential idempotency, changed-key rejection, and fake Vertex lookup recovery are tested.
risks.detection_gap: Concurrent/crash windows and distributed dispatch ownership are unverified.
risks.required_detection_test: Race identical requests and crash immediately before/after external creation; reconcile one run, one job, one reservation, and one result.

mitigation.owner: Control service, durable state store, and dispatch broker
controls: Persist immutable intent/fingerprint and a transactional dispatch outbox with unique idempotency keys.
Serialize dispatch ownership with revision/fencing checks; bind cloud jobs to stable platform IDs and reconcile them before another creation attempt.
Use provider idempotency where actually supported; block redispatch of uncertain creation outcomes until authoritative reconciliation, with bounded recovery and accounting.
mitigation.positive_verification: Sequential, concurrent, and interrupted retries resolve one effective run, job, reservation, and result.
mitigation.negative_verification: Crash before/after creation, lose the response, expire an ownership lease, and race requests; no blind second paid job is created and uncertain outcomes remain visible.
mitigation.remaining_risk: External creation and local transactions are not automatically atomic; provider visibility delays and unresolved outcomes can delay recovery.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Job state lies or cancellation leaves resources running
risks.regression: One module marks success/failure/cancellation while another has unfinished outputs or a still-running cloud job.
risks.current_evidence: Some transition rejection and workflow callback tests exist; historical smoke cancellations were observed manually.
risks.detection_gap: Workflow marks running on submission and records timeout/poll failure without canceling/reconciling Vertex.
risks.required_detection_test: Lose callbacks, expire a deadline, stop the workflow, and delay outputs; compare state to actual Vertex and artifact readiness until reconciled.

mitigation.owner: Durable workflow, run store, and operations reconciler
controls: Record observed cloud state with authenticated events, revision checks, immutable job identity, and explicit finalization/uncertainty status.
On cancellation/deadline, request actual cancellation and reconcile until externally confirmed terminal; keep uncertain jobs accounted for.
Run an independent recovery reconciler and alert on orphaned/stopping jobs; reject contradictory or replayed transitions.
mitigation.positive_verification: Observed job state, artifact readiness, and platform state agree; a canceled job is confirmed terminal.
mitigation.negative_verification: Drop/replay callbacks, stop the workflow, lose poll/cancel responses, and delay artifacts; no false running/success/stopped claim or unaccounted live job follows.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Cloud outages and delayed cancellation can prolong resource use; correct uncertainty handling does not guarantee instantaneous shutdown.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Budget policy is bypassed across modules
risks.origin: Existing, enlarged by split cost ownership
risks.regression: Dataset preparation, scans, builds, retries, GPU work, or retained resources fall outside the admitted estimate/reservation.
risks.current_evidence: Local configured per-run over-cap rejection is tested.
risks.detection_gap: Price is caller-provided; aggregate trusted reservations and ancillary costs are not enforced.
risks.required_detection_test: Inject a zero rate, omitted cost, changed shape, and simultaneous reservations; verify no paid dispatch and reconcile campaign exposure.

mitigation.owner: Budget admission service and platform operator
controls: Use operator-owned conservative price profiles covering preparation/scans, builds, GPU/CPU/disk, retries, transfers, storage, logs, and retained resources.
Reserve campaign and per-run estimated exposure atomically before dispatch; recheck changed shapes and account for uncertain jobs and concurrent work.
Enforce execution/scan/scale/duration limits, headroom, cleanup policy, and delayed billing reconciliation; reject unknown/unbounded cost.
mitigation.positive_verification: Eligible work has a complete trusted estimate and reservation within the accepted campaign policy.
mitigation.negative_verification: Submit zero caller prices, omit a resource category, alter shapes after review, exhaust retry limits, or race reservations; paid dispatch is denied and reservations remain coherent.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Provider billing lag, price changes, retained storage, and delayed cancellation remain uncertain; an estimate/reservation is not an instantaneous hard bill cap.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Lineage is lost or assigned to the wrong model
risks.regression: Dataset, weights, runtime, run, MLflow version, and release references diverge across handoffs.
risks.current_evidence: Dataset provenance, controller snapshots, portable bundles, and local MLflow reuse provide partial checks.
risks.detection_gap: No complete cross-service integrity-bound lineage reconciliation.
risks.required_detection_test: Trace one immutable identity chain end to end; deliberately swap each ID/digest and ensure registration/release refuses the mismatch.

mitigation.owner: Primary integration owner, result finalizer, and MLflow/release adapters
controls: Define one immutable lineage chain spanning object, dataset, weights, runtime, experiment/run, result digest, registry version, and release.
Generate metadata from accepted records instead of independently supplied copies; reconcile references and checksums at each handoff.
Reject missing/mismatched lineage before candidate eligibility, promotion, or serving; preserve an append-only evidence index.
mitigation.positive_verification: An object/run/model/release can be traced end to end to the exact accepted artifacts.
mitigation.negative_verification: Swap each ID/hash, replay another object's result, or lose a metadata write; no wrongly attributed eligible candidate or release is produced.
mitigation.remaining_risk: A shared verifier bug or compromised authoritative records can make internally consistent but false lineage.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Wrong or unapproved model reaches serving
risks.regression: Infrastructure treats a deployment request as approval, or alias/deployment/traffic/ledger disagree.
risks.current_evidence: Local missing-approver and selected promotion/rollback compensation tests exist.
risks.detection_gap: Approval is text, serving resolves mutable champion, and live readiness/concurrent/crash release checks are absent.
risks.required_detection_test: Use authenticated approval bound to an exact release; race promotions, change aliases, fail each cutover stage, and verify approved model identity plus rollback.

mitigation.owner: Authenticated human approval service, release controller, and serving operator
controls: Bind explicit authenticated human approval to the exact staged release fingerprint and scope; candidate writers cannot change production aliases.
Pin immutable model artifact/version and serving digest; verify readiness and model identity before traffic cutover.
Serialize release transitions and persist recoverable intent; reconcile alias, deployment, traffic, and ledger, with verified rollback to a prior approved release.
mitigation.positive_verification: An approved exact model serves healthy inference, and an approved rollback restores the expected prior model.
mitigation.negative_verification: Forge/replay approval, change aliases or artifacts, race promotions/rollback, and fail every cutover stage; no unapproved traffic or falsely completed release remains.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Control-service compromise, hidden health defects, and multi-system outages can still cause temporary inconsistency or disruption.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Telemetry cannot expose a regression
risks.regression: Module handoffs lose IDs, omit failures, leak context, or report delivery although evidence never reaches the sink.
risks.current_evidence: Structured JSON/context code and old probe Cloud Logging observations exist.
risks.detection_gap: No telemetry-specific suite or live Loki end-to-end acceptance.
risks.required_detection_test: Trace a run across all modules, inject concurrent context and collector failures, and query the real sink for correctly attributed events and explicit gaps.

mitigation.owner: Shared telemetry library, module owners, and observability operator
controls: Require a versioned event schema and propagated object/run/job/dataset/runtime/release/trace context at every boundary.
Redact secrets/private payloads; emit structured stdout and configure bounded export/buffering with explicit delivery gaps.
Gate live integration on searchable Loki/collector evidence, correlated traces/metrics, independent failure signals, and context-isolation checks.
mitigation.positive_verification: All required lifecycle and failure events are correctly correlated at the configured sink without secret canaries.
mitigation.negative_verification: Lose the collector, drop events, mix concurrent contexts, insert secret canaries, and exhaust buffers; detect the gaps/violations without false delivered status or unbounded resources.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Instrumentation omissions, sink outages, and retention gaps can still remove evidence; logs do not substitute for independent state checks.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Mixed versions or migration damage historical state
risks.regression: Old records, active runs, or independently upgraded modules become unreadable or are reinterpreted incorrectly.
risks.current_evidence: Strict present-day schemas exist.
risks.detection_gap: No schema migration, mixed-version rollout, or historical replay campaign.
risks.required_detection_test: Replay historical records and simulate old/new producer/consumer combinations with active runs; reject unsupported transitions without rewriting accepted history.

mitigation.owner: Contract integration owner and state-store/operator
controls: Maintain versioned schemas, compatibility rules, and explicit transformations; preserve immutable accepted records and provenance.
Use additive rollout before retiring old readers; bind active runs to their original supported contracts and prevent silent reinterpretation.
Back up state, dry-run historical/active-run replay in isolation, and verify restore/reconciliation before irreversible migration.
mitigation.positive_verification: Supported old/new pairs and restored active runs preserve identity and behavior without duplicate work.
mitigation.negative_verification: Introduce unsupported versions, fail mid-migration, replay stale state, and resume active runs; no accepted history is overwritten or completed job resubmitted.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Undocumented historical records, rollback limitations, and uncommon active-run states can still complicate recovery.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Guided setup and navigation become confusing or broken
risks.regression: Module separation leaks implementation details, changes command paths, or leaves missing project/run/artifact links.
risks.current_evidence: A guided CLI fixture checks project creation and returned run ID; templates and docs are present.
risks.detection_gap: Complete generated artifact indexes and actual non-programmer navigation are unverified.
risks.required_detection_test: Run the same plain-language brief through setup, review, submission, status, artifact discovery, and failure recovery; verify all generated links.

mitigation.owner: CLI/template/navigation owner and project reviewer
controls: Preserve one guided entry point and generate readable project/run/model indexes from authoritative records.
Version templates and validate configuration/link/command shapes; expose actionable failures without leaking module plumbing into routine use.
Exercise realistic briefs and human navigation tasks from setup through review, status, artifacts, and recovery.
mitigation.positive_verification: A non-programmer can complete the documented flow and locate all expected evidence.
mitigation.negative_verification: Break a template/link, remove a required field, change a command, or interrupt setup; validation catches it and the user receives a truthful next action.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Ambiguous instructions and user expectations cannot be fully captured by automated fixture checks.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Execution waiting returns to the agent
risks.regression: Modules call one another through an agent session rather than durable runtime handoffs.
risks.current_evidence: Workflow template owns polling and local control tests use a workflow handoff.
risks.detection_gap: No deployed agent-disconnect or durable resumption acceptance.
risks.required_detection_test: Close the CLI and agent after admission, interrupt the control service, and verify the workflow finishes/reconciles without assistant polling or repeated setup.

mitigation.owner: Control-plane and GCP Workflows owners
controls: Persist setup/accepted intent and dispatch through runtime services with durable workflow/event handoffs.
Give the assistant proposal capabilities only; require no agent session, polling loop, or execution lease after admission.
Prove detached execution and recovery after CLI, assistant, and control-service interruption.
mitigation.positive_verification: An admitted job runs/finalizes or reconciles while the assistant and CLI are closed.
mitigation.negative_verification: Terminate the agent and restart services mid-run; no repeated agent questions, token-consuming wait loop, or lost execution authority occurs.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Workflow/control-service availability can delay recovery, though it should not require assistant participation.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Extra artifact transfers increase cost or latency
risks.regression: Module boundaries copy large data/models repeatedly or add unbounded validation/download work.
risks.current_evidence: Shard policies and several timeout settings exist.
risks.detection_gap: No representative load/transfer benchmark, accepted SLO profile, or complete usage telemetry.
risks.required_detection_test: Measure representative bytes, downloads, memory, stage duration, and cost against an accepted baseline; inject over-limit input and observe bounded rejection.

mitigation.owner: Dataset/trainer/runtime owners and cost/performance operator
controls: Pass immutable references across modules instead of copying bulk artifacts; use bounded streaming, shard sizing, and checksum-keyed caching where allowed.
Avoid redundant full reads while preserving integrity; enforce transfer, memory, concurrency, timeout, and scale limits.
Benchmark representative workloads against accepted latency/resource/cost profiles and record regressions before production release.
mitigation.positive_verification: Measured representative workloads meet the accepted profile with traceable transfer/resource usage.
mitigation.negative_verification: Increase artifact sizes/concurrency, force cache misses, or introduce duplicate downloads; enforce limits and fail the performance/cost gate.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Real input distributions, cache behavior, cloud contention, and variable network/storage costs keep this target uncertain.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Failures are attributed to the wrong owner
risks.regression: A wrapper removes the original failure context and triggers the wrong repair, retry, or rebuild.
risks.current_evidence: Selected failure owner/retryability tests exist; the DINOv3 fix was assigned to trainer code.
risks.detection_gap: Complete cross-module failure taxonomy and recovery authorization are unverified.
risks.required_detection_test: Inject trainer, data, image, permission, quota, registry, and serving failures through real boundaries; verify owner, preserved evidence, and permitted next action.

mitigation.owner: Failure taxonomy owner and each owning engineering role
controls: Use typed failure records containing stage, owner, retryability, original cause, artifact/job identity, and permitted next action.
Preserve causes through adapters; unknown errors remain explicitly unclassified and cannot authorize cross-role repair.
Gate retries/repair/build actions on classification plus actor capability; test failures through real module boundaries.
mitigation.positive_verification: Each known fault reaches the correct owner with usable original evidence and a permitted response.
mitigation.negative_verification: Wrap/mislabel errors or present trainer faults as packaging/quota faults; no unauthorized edit, blind retry, or unrelated rebuild follows.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Novel failures and ambiguous external messages still need human diagnosis.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Untrusted model artifact executes code or escapes its path
risks.origin: Existing, enlarged by artifact trust boundary
risks.regression: A typed TrainingResult points to malicious checkpoint content or unsafe download paths accepted by another module.
risks.current_evidence: Weight checksums and no-hub-fallback tests establish partial integrity behavior.
risks.detection_gap: Inference uses weights_only=False; complete provenance-before-deserialization and path containment are not established.
risks.required_detection_test: Use safe malicious canaries, substituted bundles, and traversal names in an isolated loader; verify rejection before deserialization/writes and unchanged filesystem/credentials.

mitigation.owner: Trainer/model-loader, runtime sandbox, and artifact policy owners
controls: Accept approved non-executable tensor artifacts with trusted provenance and integrity verification before deserialization; reject unsafe/unapproved formats and remote code.
Enforce contained download/extraction paths, source allowlists, byte/dimension/resource limits, and bundle schema.
Load/infer under least privilege with scoped credentials and constrained filesystem/network access; verify malicious canaries in an isolated environment.
mitigation.positive_verification: Approved portable bundles load and infer with the intended resource/identity restrictions.
mitigation.negative_verification: Use substituted checkpoint content, unsafe serializer canaries, traversal paths, and hostile image data; reject before execution/escaped writes and inspect filesystem/credentials afterward.
mitigation.remaining_risk: Parser vulnerabilities, dependency supply-chain compromise, and sandbox defects remain possible with severe consequences.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

risks.title: Infrastructure capabilities are stale or only desired state
risks.origin: Existing, enlarged by infrastructure output contract
risks.regression: Training trusts endpoints, identities, quota, region, network, or readiness declared in config but not true in the environment.
risks.current_evidence: Infrastructure templates and historical quota/API observations exist.
risks.detection_gap: OpenTofu provider/deployment validation and current live readiness are unverified; historical GPU success is not current capacity.
risks.required_detection_test: Compare capability output with observed resource identities/revisions; revoke access/change endpoints/quota and verify revalidation denies or reports uncertainty before paid execution.

mitigation.owner: Infrastructure operator and readiness/admission service
controls: Separate desired deployment configuration from observed capability output; record environment/resource revisions, identity, endpoints, policy scope, and observation time.
Validate OpenTofu/providers/plans and reconcile actual resources/drift; restrict trusted publication of capability records.
Recheck readiness/access and relevant quota/constraints at admission; stale/unknown facts fail closed or enter explicit uncertainty with bounded recovery.
mitigation.positive_verification: The selected environment and execution identity match observed resources and can perform the intended bounded operation.
mitigation.negative_verification: Revoke access, alter endpoints/regions/resources, change quotas, or replay stale capabilities; revalidation detects drift before unauthorized work or records capacity uncertainty.
mitigation.remaining_risk: GPU quota does not guarantee available capacity; cloud drift and availability can change after a successful preflight.
mitigation.required_evidence: Reviewed implementation; supported-contract semantic checks; recorded positive/negative cases at necessary scopes; exact source/image/config/environment/principal bindings; independent before/after state; owner reassessment.

mitigation_assessment.method: Target residual R = target L × original I, rounded half up to two decimals. Original impacts are retained. Likelihood reductions require preventive controls plus verified gates. Detection alone is not multiplied into R.
conditions: All controls in the specific mitigation are implemented and reviewed.
Positive and negative checks pass at required local/live scopes with independently checked effects.
Compatibility, active-run, resource, and recovery assumptions are satisfied.
No contradictory evidence remains; the owner reviews the score against actual results.
limits: Targets are subjective conditional planning estimates, not measured probabilities or guarantees.
No mitigation implementation, mutation campaign, paid resource, or new live acceptance is claimed.
Current risk and current detection ratings remain unchanged until evidence supports reassessment.
Scores are not added or averaged into an overall incident probability.
Prerequisite infrastructure/endpoints/weights/profiles and authorized campaign budget are still required for live verification.
